; 16 8 bit  of data are stored in memory location
;  4050H to 405FH.Transfer the entire block of data
; to new memory location starting at 4870H.

;CODE:
       ORG 8000H
       LXI H,4050H
       LXI D,4870H
       MVI B,10H
LOOP:  MOV A,M
       STAX D
       INX H
       INX D
       DCR B
       JNZ LOOP
       HLT
       ORG 4050H
       DB 01H,01H,02H,03H,04H,05H,06H,07H,08H,09H,0AH,0BH,0CH,0DH,0EH,0FH
       END
